# Hype cycle

A sketch of how expectations about a new technology move: a trigger, a peak of inflated expectations, a trough of disillusionment, then a slow climb to ordinary usefulness.

## Reading it as a small technology surge

The peak is a bubble in miniature: money and attention flood in and too much is built too early. The trough is the bust. The climb afterwards is deployment, when the technology becomes cheap and boring and finally useful.

## Doubt

Many technologies never leave the trough. The curve describes the survivors. Expectations also feed on themselves on the way up, see [[Reflexivity]].
